reason: Discovery completed all three configured intelligence pipelines for the run date, resolved every due P0 source, and retained 13 normalized same-day GitHub engineering signals. Topic selection remains exclusively owned by Queue, so all three column decisions remain Waiting.
reason_zh: Discovery 已完成运行日三条配置情报管线，解析全部到期 P0 来源，并保留 13 个规范化的同日 GitHub 工程信号。选题仍完全由 Queue 负责，因此三个栏目决定均保持 Waiting。

pipelines.label: AI Platform Change Intelligence
pipelines.reason: All 45 configured public P0 platform channels were checked against current authoritative surfaces. No material 2026-08-15 platform mechanism change survived normalization and same-day filtering.
pipelines.reason_zh: 已检查全部 45 个配置的公开 P0 平台渠道，并以当前权威页面为准核验。经机制规范化与同日过滤后，没有保留 2026-08-15 的重要平台机制变化。

pipelines.label: GitHub Engineering Intelligence
pipelines.reason: All nine P0 daily repositories were checked. Material same-day maintainer changes were normalized into 13 unselected signals, with related commits on the same underlying mechanism deduplicated.
pipelines.reason_zh: 已检查全部 9 个 P0 每日仓库。同日重要维护者变更经规范化后形成 13 个未选题信号；同一底层机制的相关提交已合并去重。

pipelines.label: Published Research Intelligence
pipelines.reason: All nine configured P0 research sources were checked. No material same-day research object meeting the configured evidence and topic rules was retained.
pipelines.reason_zh: 已检查全部 9 个配置的 P0 研究来源。没有保留符合配置证据与主题规则的重要同日研究对象。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.reason: Discovery recorded two primary-column signals; Queue must independently score and decide selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录 2 个以该栏目为主栏目的信号；后续必须由 Queue 独立评分并决定是否选题。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.reason: Discovery recorded seven primary-column signals; Queue must independently score and decide selection.
columns.reason_zh: Discovery 记录 7 个以该栏目为主栏目的信号；后续必须由 Queue 独立评分并决定是否选题。

signals.title: Codex preserves per-environment permission and configuration ownership
signals.title_zh: Codex 保留每个环境的权限与配置所有权
signals.summary: Codex now retains whether an environment attachment inherits thread configuration or owns its own configuration, while honoring per-environment permission profiles across updates and child-thread snapshots.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在会保留环境附件是继承线程配置还是拥有自身配置，并在后续更新与子线程快照中继续遵守每个环境独立的权限配置。

signals.title: Codex forwards executor network policy decisions for audit
signals.title_zh: Codex 将执行器网络策略决定转发用于审计
signals.summary: Executor-local proxy decisions are forwarded as best-effort policy notifications, validated against the active process, and converted into audit events with controller-trusted execution metadata.
signals.summary_zh: 执行器本地代理的策略决定会以尽力而为的策略通知转发，并对照活动进程核验，随后以控制器可信的执行元数据写入审计事件。

signals.title: Codex adds MCP protocol discovery observability
signals.title_zh: Codex 增加 MCP 协议发现可观测性
signals.summary: Codex records counters and durations for MCP client protocol discovery and classifies outcomes as modern, legacy, or failure under the configured negotiation mode.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为 MCP 客户端协议发现记录计数与耗时，并按照配置的协商模式将结果分类为现代协议、旧协议或失败。

signals.title: Codex sources multi-agent role instructions from the model catalog
signals.title_zh: Codex 从模型目录提供多 Agent 角色指令
signals.summary: Root and subagent role instructions, delegation guidance, and model-specific refresh behavior are now supplied through the model catalog with explicit fallback precedence.
signals.summary_zh: 根 Agent 与子 Agent 的角色指令、委派指导以及模型切换后的刷新行为现在由模型目录提供，并具有明确的回退优先级。

signals.title: Codex makes Guardian v2 risk classification policy-driven and configurable
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Guardian v2 风险分类改为策略驱动且可配置
signals.summary: Guardian v2 risk classification can now resolve security policy and configurable classifier thresholds, reasoning effort, token budgets, and transcript controls instead of relying on one fixed review configuration.
signals.summary_zh: Guardian v2 风险分类现在可以解析安全策略，并配置分类阈值、推理强度、Token 预算与上下文记录控制，而不再依赖单一固定评审配置。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK sandbox honors view_image path grants
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 沙箱遵守 view_image 路径授权
signals.summary: The sandbox path policy now honors extra path grants used by view_image operations, tightening consistency between declared tool permissions and filesystem access.
signals.summary_zh: 沙箱路径策略现在会遵守 view_image 操作使用的额外路径授权，使工具声明权限与文件系统访问之间更加一致。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK stops exposing the mutable MCP tools cache to callers
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 不再向调用方暴露可变 MCP 工具缓存
signals.summary: MCP tool-cache ownership is hardened so callers no longer receive the internal cache object directly, reducing accidental shared-state mutation across tool discovery consumers.
signals.summary_zh: MCP 工具缓存的所有权得到收紧，调用方不再直接获得内部缓存对象，从而减少工具发现消费者之间意外修改共享状态的风险。

signals.title: Google ADK adds native A2A task-mode execution
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 增加原生 A2A Task 模式执行
signals.summary: RemoteA2aAgent can execute in native task mode, including finish-task registration, delegation-scope aggregation, and terminal-state mapping in the A2A executor.
signals.summary_zh: RemoteA2aAgent 可以使用原生 Task 模式执行，包括注册 finish-task 工具、聚合委派任务作用域以及在 A2A 执行器中映射终态。

signals.title: Google ADK cancels background tool tasks when a live agent run ends
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Live Agent 运行结束时取消后台工具任务
signals.summary: Live-agent runs now own and cancel streaming or non-blocking background tool tasks during handoff or teardown, and release stale stream registry entries instead of allowing orphaned tasks to continue.
signals.summary_zh: Live Agent 运行现在会在交接或结束时负责取消流式或非阻塞后台工具任务，并释放陈旧的流注册项，避免孤儿任务继续运行。

signals.title: Google ADK validates session initialization events and tightens HITL resumption
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 校验会话初始化事件并收紧 HITL 恢复
signals.summary: ADK prevents client-supplied session initialization events from seeding runtime state and tightens confirmation handling when resuming human-in-the-loop execution.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 阻止客户端提供的会话初始化事件直接注入运行时状态，并在恢复人在回路执行时收紧确认处理。

signals.title: Google ADK propagates the caller RunConfig into AgentTool execution
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 将调用方 RunConfig 传播到 AgentTool 执行
signals.summary: AgentTool execution now runs under the caller's RunConfig so execution settings remain attached across the agent-as-tool boundary.
signals.summary_zh: AgentTool 现在会在调用方的 RunConfig 下执行，使执行设置能够跨越“Agent 作为工具”的边界继续生效。

signals.title: Google ADK adds memory identity and topic restrictions to Vertex Memory Bank
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 为 Vertex Memory Bank 增加记忆身份与主题限制
signals.summary: Vertex Memory Bank integration adds memory_id and allowed_topics controls, making memory selection and topical scope explicit runtime inputs.
signals.summary_zh: Vertex Memory Bank 集成新增 memory_id 与 allowed_topics 控制，使记忆选择和主题作用域成为显式运行时输入。

signals.title: Google ADK includes grounding metadata in rubric judging
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在量表评判中纳入 Grounding 元数据
signals.summary: Rubric-judge prompts now include grounding metadata, expanding the evidence context available to automated evaluation rather than judging only the visible response content.
signals.summary_zh: 量表评判提示现在会包含 Grounding 元数据，使自动评估能够使用更完整的证据上下文，而不只是判断可见响应内容。
